summary: Iteration 18 - All requested features tested and PASSED. Backend: Copy device returns image_gridfs_id as string, document download requires auth (403 without). Frontend: Gesamt filter resets to all devices, device image shows in ServicePlan header, document download uses auth-based buttons not plain links.

copy_device_image_gridfs_id_as_string.result: Response includes image_gridfs_id as string type, copied device keeps same image reference

document_download_with_auth.result: Returns 200 with auth, 403 without auth. Document content returned correctly.

gesamt_filter_resets_all.test: Clicking 'Gesamt' filter card resets all filters and shows ALL devices
gesamt_filter_resets_all.result: Initial count: 9, after Einsatzbereit filter: 4, after Gesamt: 9 devices shown. Toggle works correctly.

all_filter_cards_clickable.test: All filter cards (Einsatzbereit, Bald fällig, Überfällig, Gesamt) are clickable
all_filter_cards_clickable.result: All 4 filter cards found with data-testid attributes, clicking filters devices correctly

device_image_in_serviceplan_header.test: ServicePlan detail view shows device image next to device name in header
device_image_in_serviceplan_header.result: Device image visible in header for XBAP2021 device, src points to /api/devices/{id}/image endpoint

document_download_uses_auth_fetch.test: Document download in Dateiablage uses button with api.get (not plain anchor link)
document_download_uses_auth_fetch.result: Dateiablage section shows documents as buttons (1 button, 0 anchor links). Click triggers authenticated download.

seed_data_creation: Used existing XBAP2021 device (07d42e9d-403e-48c6-8904-47f2f3323965) with image, 2 parts, and 1 document for frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 complete. All 4 user-requested features verified: (1) Copy device returns image_gridfs_id as string in response, (2) Gesamt filter card is a button that sets statusFilter(null) showing all devices, (3) ServicePlan detail header shows device image via img tag with src to /api/devices/{id}/image, (4) Document download uses button with api.get(responseType:'blob') for authenticated download.
